candidates.reason: The dark panel grows to swallow the can, so the product sits on charcoal and loses the green backdrop that set its mood. The panel bleeds off the left, right and bottom edges with clipped corners. The can floats in a big empty middle zone, and the bottom 120px of the panel is dead space.

The top keeps the original structure, but the panel runs flush off the left, right and bottom edges, so it reads as a cropped slab instead of an inset card. There is a large dead gap of about 110px between the headline and the CTA. The CTA is bigger than the original's, but the panel's lower edge looks unresolved.

This is essentially a shrunk copy of the square. The headline and CTA are crammed together at reduced size in the top third of the panel, leaving the lower half of the panel empty. A roughly 130px band of empty green below the panel makes the layout top-heavy and not adapted to the taller format.

This is the best adaptation of the four: the can and logo are well placed on the green, and the headline and CTA have good scale. The panel still bleeds off the side and bottom edges with no margin, which breaks the original's inset card. There is an oversized empty gap between the headline and the CTA.
